about: One of the three answers of exercise 3: a reply drafted from the strong brief.
constructed_note: Constructed for the build as a stand-in, with its errors written in on purpose. No assistant produced this text. A real recording is owed: send the request file to an assistant, and where an error has to be planted by editing the real answer, say so in 'edits' in plain words.

key.reason: True: {staffFirst} promised to confirm a day by Friday (message 4) and did not (message 5). Owning the mistake first is right.

{cupsDelivered} cartons were delivered, not {cupsOrdered}: {cupsOrdered} is what was ordered (message 3). The automatic check cannot see this, because {cupsOrdered} is in the thread with another meaning.
True to the policy: a credit of this size needs the {managerRole}'s approval (rule 3), and it promises nothing.

The policy does not allow paying for goods bought elsewhere without the {managerRole}'s agreement in writing, and says never to promise it by e-mail (rules 5 and 6). The figure is right; the promise is not allowed.
A promise about {staffFirst}'s own action, which he can keep. It does not promise a delivery day.
